slug: 2026-01-19 Ivory Coast Launches MaPoste to Digitize Postal and Administrative Services

systems.owner: La Poste de Côte d'Ivoire with ONECI
systems.tiers: smartphone application launched 16 January 2026, backed by more than 200 post agencies; request and tracking of official documents including criminal records

note: A postal application through which the public can request a criminal-record certificate among other documents; nothing on police or gendarmerie stations or their records.
